question.text: An option writer must be aware that ___ is a distinct possibility:

answer.text: Assignment (being required to fulfill the obligation if the buyer exercises)
The option being cancelled by the exchange
The premium being refunded to the buyer
The strike price being changed by the exchange

explanation.text: The Logic: Option writers can be assigned when the buyer exercises, meaning the writer must fulfil the obligation under the contract. Assignment is described in the workbook as a distinct possibility the writer should be aware of. For European-style options exercise can occur only on the expiration date, and exchange-traded currency options in India are cash settled, with exercised ITM options allocated/assigned by the clearing system. The Trap: Exchanges do not unilaterally cancel options, refund premiums, or change strike prices once the contract is open. The real risk to the writer is being assigned when the buyer exercises. Note: Workbook references — p.80 (option writers can be assigned on exercise), p.68 (European options exercisable only on expiration), pp.166 and 169 (cash settlement and assignment/allocation of exercised ITM options).
